categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily develops, manufactures, and sells computer peripherals including power supplies, computer cases, and electronic components. It also operates in the gaming peripherals market with its own brand Apexgaming, and has diversified into air purification products using photocatalyst technology under the brand HYPURE. Additionally, it produces power cables for RVs, camping vehicles, engines, and yachts.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced power supply technologies such as half-bridge LLC resonant architecture and DC to DC design, achieving high efficiency and stable output. It integrates patented AI-compatible power supply designs and photocatalyst nanotechnology for air purification products. Manufacturing processes include precision layout for heat dissipation, high integration of PCBA components, and outsourcing low value-added processes like stamping and assembly to control costs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include mainstream gaming brands and global retail channels, with a focus on North America, China, and Europe. The company serves the gaming PC market, AI server power supply market, and air quality health-conscious consumers. It also targets RV, camping vehicle, and yacht industries for power cable products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan and China with manufacturing subsidiaries in Dongguan. Its sales markets include Taiwan, China, Hong Kong, the United States, and other global regions, with emphasis on the Americas, China, and Europe for its gaming brand expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on design, manufacturing, and assembly of power supplies, computer cases, and related peripherals. It maintains strong supplier relationships for key raw materials and components and engages in OEM/ODM production for certain product lines.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the gaming brand Apexgaming globally, developing AI-compatible power supplies, and innovating in photocatalyst air purification technology. The company emphasizes ESG and sustainability, investing in energy-efficient designs and environmentally friendly materials. R&D efforts focus on product diversification, improving manufacturing efficiency, and integrating health-conscious features into gaming peripherals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of power supplies, computer cases, gaming peripherals, and air purification devices. The company also earns rental income from leasing idle factory space. It leverages OEM/ODM contracts and direct sales of its own brands to global markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces intense competition from mainland Chinese PC manufacturers, especially in low-margin products. It positions itself competitively in the high-end power supply market with advanced technology and patented innovations. Its gaming brand Apexgaming and patented photocatalyst air purifiers provide differentiation in niche markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported revenues of approximately NT$278 million, an 8.44% increase from the prior year, with a pre-tax profit turnaround from a loss to NT$6.86 million. Total assets are around NT$1.71 billion with steady growth in equity. The company shows a positive growth trajectory supported by expanding gaming power supply orders and diversified product lines.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-efficiency, compact, and AI-compatible power supplies with patented technology, offering stable and quiet operation tailored for gaming and AI server markets. Its photocatalyst air purification products provide sustainable, filter-free solutions with multiple patents and health certifications. The integration of air purification into gaming peripherals and focus on health-conscious designs differentiate its offerings.
